rationale: Core genome statistics (length, GC ~0.03% delta, gene counts, RNAs, pseudogenes) match exactly or near-exactly using the same public assembly/annotation, strongly supporting reproducibility. Comparative-genome dataset existence/availability is verified (sampled accessions resolve to complete genomes), though not exhaustively re-run. CAZyme totals differ modestly (102 vs 108) with category shifts (CE lower, CBM higher) plausibly explained by dbCAN/HMMdb versioning and pipeline differences; key cold-adaptation CAZyme families are fully recovered.
